F1.value: Tickets (solc 0.8.6) verified; TicketBooth, TerminalV1 and TerminalDirectory also verified. GoPlus is_open_source=1

F2.value: Tickets.print is onlyOwner = TicketBooth (immutable; no transferOwnership path). TicketBooth.print is onlyTerminal(36) = TerminalV1 0xd569...4431. TerminalV1 pay() mints (1 - reservedRate) x weight to the payer; reservedRate = 200/200, so payers get 0. Reserved tickets go via printReservedTickets to the project owner 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001787 as staked tickets (no ticket mods set). printPreminedTickets is closed (payments already made). Only the project owner can configure or migrate. GoPlus is_mintable=1 reflects the owner-gated print() function. Caveat: a mint path technically still exists, but it only credits an address with no known key
F2.source: verified source (Blockscout) Tickets/TicketBooth/TerminalV1; eth_call currentOf(36), ticketModsOf(36,1637538371) = empty; GoPlus is_mintable=1

F3.value: Tickets owner = TicketBooth contract (GoPlus owner_address 0xee2e...bfc; can_take_back_ownership=0). Project #36 NFT, which holds configure/migrate/operator rights, was sent on 2021-12-21 (tx 0x466d6255...5311) from 0xb1C9...9322 to 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001787. That address has no code (eth_getCode = 0x) and is treated here as renounced: a vanity 'burn' address ('1787'), so a known private key is cryptographically infeasible. Operator grants can only come from the current owner. TerminalV1 governance 0xac43...b3 can only allowMigration and setFee; it can't touch project 36 supply. Flag for the reviewer: strictly it is a codeless address, not 0x0/0xdead
